summary: Today's one-hour Diwali session opens on the back of heavy foreign buying and a strong week, but thin festive volumes and an unresolved Gulf standoff make it a poor guide to Monday.

detail.leaders: Large caps foreign investors bought heavily last week
detail.laggards: Consumer names with weak quarters, such as Jubilant FoodWorks, and any stock hit by renewed oil worries
detail.tone: Markets ended a strong week with a big Friday rally, and Saturday brought no new market-moving news beyond Qatar's US-Iran proposal. Today's session is short and ceremonial; Monday Nov 9 is the next full session, and Tuesday Nov 10 is a holiday.
